title: the-shake-hands-postprocess-the-stamps
intention: The nest is the shared machine at cairn/machines/nest/ (outline 16.2): its bands are preprocess, measure, postprocess, and its shake runs band-outer. A preprocess sieve gets the whole subject set; a measure sieve cuts one subject; a postprocess sieve gets the stamps of every subject and stamps each survivor with a rank, and the shake hands back the survivors in rank order (outline 11.4.6, Akien 2026-09-29: option c). Its two tenants import it there, and the copy under cairn/tools/base leaves.
how: Create cairn/machines/nest/ with nest.py carrying BAND_NAMES {0: preprocess, 1: measure, 2: postprocess}, nest(reaches) unchanged, and shake(assembled, subjects, fire) band-outer: band 0 calls fire(name, subjects) and scores only the returned keys, band 1 calls fire(name, subject) as today, then band 2 calls fire(name, subject, stamps) for each subject rolling up 1.0, stamps being the gradation across every subject, and records the return as ranks[subject][name] outside gradation and roll_up; the result gains ranks and order. Move test_nest.py there and add a red-first proof. Repoint the two tenants' import lines (inspector.py:80, route.py:42) and the places that name the module path; delete cairn/tools/base/nest.py, its proof and its watch probe; strike nest from the base charter.

clauses.claim: over a fixture nest with one sieve per band and three subjects, every measure sieve fires over every subject before any postprocess sieve fires (the recorded fire order)

a postprocess sieve is called fire(name, subject, stamps) once for each subject rolling up 1.0 after the measure band, stamps holding the measure scores of all three subjects, and its return is recorded as ranks[subject][name] and changes neither gradation nor roll_up
a preprocess sieve is called once with the whole subject set; a subject it does not return carries no score for any later sieve and rolls up 1.0
with only measure sieves the shake's findings, gradation and roll_up equal the old subject-outer shake's over the same fixture, and order is the subjects rolling up 1.0 in name order
cairn/tools/base/nest.py is absent, and no .py file under cairn/ or bin/ imports cairn.tools.base.nest
order lists exactly the subjects rolling up 1.0, sorted by the tuple of their ranks in the assembled order of the band-2 sieves, ties by subject name

traces_to: Outline 16.2 (the nest machine) and 11.4.6 (route built with the nest, cheapest survivor first); Law 1 (the compare the bands were built for is settled structure); RULE 1 (one component per ticket).

decisions.text: D1: cairn/machines/nest/__init__.py (empty) and cairn/machines/nest/nest.py: the body of cairn/tools/base/nest.py moved, BAND_NAMES = {0: 'preprocess', 1: 'measure', 2: 'postprocess'}, shake rewritten band-outer as the how says. A band-0 sieve's return is a collection of subject names; subjects outside it get no score from that sieve or any later one. Band 2 runs after bands 0 and 1 have fired over every subject, only over the subjects rolling up 1.0; its stamps argument is the gradation dict (every subject's band 0 and 1 scores); its return is any comparable value, kept as ranks[subject][name]. shake returns findings, gradation, roll_up, ranks ({subject: {sieve: rank}} for the survivors) and order (the survivors sorted by (tuple(ranks[s][n] for each band-2 sieve n in assembled order), s)). Docstrings say measure where they said record, and that a rank is a postprocess stamp, never a cut score.

D2: move cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_nest.py to cairn/machines/nest/proofs/test_nest.py importing cairn.machines.nest.nest, its BAND_NAMES assertion reading measure; its seal cairn/tools/base/validations/test_nest.json leaves through bin/cairn artifact remove <path> --why, and the moved proof is sealed fresh.

D3: the red-first proof cairn/machines/nest/proofs/test_the_shake_runs_band_outer.py, PROVES {'71cd4a62e8c5': {'1': 'band_one_is_measure', '2': 'measure_fires_over_every_subject_first', '3': 'postprocess_receives_every_stamp', '4': 'preprocess_picks_the_subjects', '5': 'a_measure_only_shake_is_unchanged', '6': 'the_base_copy_is_gone', '7': 'order_follows_the_ranks'}}; tooth 5 holds a frozen copy of the old subject-outer loop inline as the reference; tooth 6 walks cairn/ and bin/ with ast for Import/ImportFrom of cairn.tools.base.nest. The house runner (main() exit 0 green).

D4: the tenants' import lines: cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py:80 and cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/route.py:42 become `from cairn.machines.nest import nest as base_nest` (the alias kept, so no other line changes). The module path string at cairn/machines/build_inspector/probes/does_the_denied_set_stay_put.py:56 and the carrier check at cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/proofs/test_route.py:185-188 name cairn.machines.nest.nest.

D5: delete cairn/tools/base/nest.py and cairn/tools/base/probes/does_the_gradation_find_a_reader.py (its enough-condition, a second carrier, is met: route.py imports the nest, test_route.py:178). Strike item (7) nest.py, the nest import from invoke, test_nest.py from proof, and cairn.tools.base.nest from public_interface in cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json, written through bin/cairn artifact write --verb charter.

why: Measured 2026-11-10: the nest lives at cairn/tools/base/nest.py, where outline 16.2 says it is a shared machine under cairn/machines/ (two users, 16.2.4); BAND_NAMES at nest.py:28 names band 1 'record' where outline 16.2.3.1 says 'measure'; and shake (nest.py:73-80) loops subject-outer and calls fire(name, subject) only, so no sieve can see another subject's stamp and route's cheapest pick is a sort after the shake (route.py:293, :301). Akien 2026-09-15: 'a different kind of compare operation performed on all the available inputs. if it's not like that now, that's a bug.'

out: route's cheapest and prefers as postprocess sieves (their own ticket, inference_domain)
the inspector's teeth sieve as postprocess (its own ticket, build_inspector)
import_sieve.phase_of (already derives postprocess from a stamps parameter, sieve.py:84)

measured.saw: nest at cairn/tools/base/nest.py; BAND_NAMES band 1 'record' (nest.py:28); shake subject-outer calling fire(name, subject) (nest.py:73-80); importers inspector.py:80 and route.py:42; route's cheapest sort at route.py:293 and prefers reorder at :301
